findings.where: Li2Mn0.66V0.33O2F_Si3N4 and _steel, steps 3-4 (addition of LiF and second milling)
findings.extracted: Both failed attempts inherit step 3 'add LiF' and step 4 'second milling' from LMOF; only 'LiF_use' is in route not_stated, the steps carry no mark.
findings.article_says: Two synthesis attempts were made, the conditions of which were analogous to the above syntheses of LMOF and LMVOF.
findings.fix: The precursors listed for the attempts (Li2O, Mn2O3, V2O3) contain no fluoride source and LiF is never named; keep the inherited steps but mark steps 3 and 4 (LiF identity, amount, second 20 h milling) as presumed from 'analogous', and add a limite_reproductibilite annotation.

findings.extracted: value_text 'analogous to LMVOF', parent_value 13:1 / 600 rpm, quote is the Fig. S1 legend
findings.fix: The article gives no ball-to-powder ratio or speed for attempt b (nor 'hardened' steel); the legend only supports the jar. Replace these three variations by a note 'conditions analogous to LMVOF, values not written' and put ball_to_powder_ratio and rotation_speed in not_stated for this route, rather than presenting 'analogous to LMVOF' as a changed value of the parent.

findings.where: HT-LMVOF characterization 'XANES Mn and V K-edges (cycled electrode)' instrument and conditions
findings.extracted: easyXAFS300+ lab device; 'samples diluted with cellulose, pressed into pellets, between Kapton tapes'
findings.article_says: Figure 8 shows the V and Mn K-edge XANES spectra of the cycled HT-LMVOF electrode in the discharged state.
findings.fix: The article does not say which instrument measured Fig. 8 (the synchrotron section is Mn K-edge on LMOF electrodes only) nor how this cycled electrode was prepared; the cellulose-pellet conditions belong to the powders and standards. Mark instrument and preparation not stated, and give the cycle number only as 'LMVOF_20C' from the caption (text says 'prolonged cycling').

findings.where: LMOF / HT-LMOF 'XAFS Mn K-edge (synchrotron, cycled electrode)' sample preparation
findings.extracted: Nothing about electrode recovery: no 'dimethyl carbonate', 'Mylar' or 'heat sealer' anywhere in the extraction
findings.article_says: After cycling (20 cycles), the tapes were washed in dimethyl carbonate and sealed in a small Mylar bag in an Ar-filled glove box using a heat sealer.
findings.fix: Add to the conditions of the two synchrotron XAFS characterizations (electrode tape of normal LMOF / HT-LMOF, 20 cycles, discharged state, washed in DMC, sealed in a Mylar bag in an Ar glove box; standards wrapped in Kapton).

findings.where: sample_inventory and LMOF / LMVOF characterizations: samples after DSC to 400 C (Fig. S3a,b)
findings.extracted: Absent from the inventory; DSC rows mention the phase transition only; no outcome on the post-DSC XRD
findings.article_says: The XRD result of the samples after DSC measurement at room temperature is shown in Figure S3. The patterns present some additional peaks which are not related to the DRS structure.
findings.fix: Add the two post-DSC samples to the inventory (results in Fig. S3, annex not available) and an outcome on LMOF and LMVOF: additional non-DRS peaks after heating to 400 C, transition only partially reversible; this is the reason for the 300 C ceiling of the heat treatment.

findings.extracted: HT-LMVOF has no CV characterization or outcome (LMOF, LMVOF and HT-LMOF have one)
findings.article_says: After the heat treatment, both samples showed sharper CV peaks.
findings.fix: Add CV for HT-LMVOF: sharper peaks than normal LMVOF (peak potentials of the HT sample are not given; Fig. S6 not available).

findings.where: HT-LMVOF and LMVOF outcomes / characterizations: Mn K-edge, Coulombic efficiency, Fe traces
findings.extracted: HT-LMVOF has V K-edge XANES only; no Coulombic efficiency; Fe traces recorded for LMVOF only
findings.article_says: The Coulombic efficiency of both the LMVOF cathodes was higher than that of the LMOFs and close to 100%.
findings.fix: Add for HT-LMVOF: Coulombic efficiency higher than the LMOFs and close to 100%; Mn K-edge near MnO ('In contrast, a lower average oxidation state near MnIIO can be observed for the LMVOF samples.'); Fe traces ('Some traces of Fe in LMVOF samples have also been detected, probably originating from the stainless steel jar.'); HT-LMVOF also shows a larger gap between the two 0.1 C sections of the rate test.

findings.where: doubt 'Électrode, ratios' and Electrode_DRS reagent 'active material (LMOF or LMVOF)'
findings.extracted: 'l'article ne dit pas explicitement que les électrodes HT ont suivi le même protocole'; active material listed as LMOF or LMVOF only
findings.article_says: Electrode tapes of normal LMOF and HT-LMOF were prepared according to the method described below.
findings.fix: The article does say it for HT-LMOF (XAFS electrodes) and tests all four samples electrochemically; reword the doubt (HT-LMVOF electrodes are implied, not written) and list the HT samples among the active materials.

findings.extracted: Authors 'montrer que la substitution partielle du Mn par V n'améliore pas la rétention de capacité de la phase de base'
findings.article_says: With respect to the normal samples, LMVOF shows a higher capacity retention after 100 cycles.
findings.fix: Normal samples: LMVOF 43.8 % vs LMOF 31.4 %, so V substitution does raise retention; after heat treatment LMOF (80.8 %) beats LMVOF (49.6 %), and the authors conclude no significant overall improvement. Reword.

findings.extracted: 'Pour les quatre échantillons, le traitement thermique augmente légèrement la taille des particules'
findings.article_says: In general, the HT samples have slightly larger particles; however, the agglomerations are still present.
findings.fix: Only the two HT samples are larger than their normal counterparts ('in general'); say 'pour LMOF et LMVOF'.

findings.extracted: 'atmosphère inerte au broyage ... protègent les poudres hygroscopiques et le lithium métallique de l'air'
findings.article_says: For synthesizing LMOF, in the first step, Li2O (99.7%, Alfa Aesar) and Mn2O3 (99%, Alfa Aesar) were mixed in a stoichiometric ratio under an inert atmosphere.
findings.fix: The authors state an inert atmosphere for mixing and for the LiF addition only (milling atmosphere is in the extraction's own not_stated), and give no reason (hygroscopy, lithium) anywhere; move the purpose to securite_analyse.

findings.where: HT-LMOF step 2 (heat), duration 5 h and not_stated list
findings.extracted: duration = 5 h, repetitions = three times; not_stated lacks dwell time and cooling between heats
findings.article_says: The pellets were then heated three times, respectively, for 5 h up to 300 °C at a constant rate of 80 °C/h under a forming gas atmosphere.
findings.fix: The reading is literal and the ambiguity is in the doubts, but a ramp of 80 C/h to 300 C already takes about 3.4-3.75 h, so '5 h' is ramp plus unknown dwell or something else; add dwell_time_at_300C, intermediate_cooling and starting temperature to step 2 not_stated.

reproducibility_gaps: no mass or mole of any precursor (only 'stoichiometric ratio'), no total powder mass per milling, no jar filling, no product recovery or yield
milling atmosphere not stated (only mixing and LiF addition are 'under an inert atmosphere'); ball material not stated for the Si3N4 and steel jars
failed Li2Mn0.66V0.33O2F attempts: LiF use and, for attempt b, ball-to-powder ratio and speed only 'analogous'; amounts absent; Fig. S1 not in the repository
heat treatment: dwell at 300 C, cooling, start temperature, number and spacing of the three heatings, pellet pressure and diameter, forming gas composition and flow, furnace
electrode: 60:30 then 10:90 ratios ambiguous (60:30:10 by mass probable, not written), NMP volume, mixing time, coating thickness, loading
cell: definition of 1 C (mA per g) and number of cycles per rate in the rate test not given; electrolyte volume; cell pressure
cycled XAS electrodes: state of charge protocol and cycle number of the Fig. 8 electrode (LMVOF_20C in caption, 'prolonged cycling' in text)
Supporting Information figures S1-S7 are caption-only in the repository
notes: Fig. 1 lattice parameters (4.221, 4.212, 4.161, 4.148 A) printed on the panels: exact match for all four. Fig. 6 1 C capacities measured by pixel calibration: normal LMVOF about 70, HT-LMOF about 101, HT-LMVOF about 77: match; normal LMOF about 135 (last five 1 C points 134-136) vs 140 extracted, 3.7 % gap, below the 10 % threshold, not reported as a finding. Table 1, Table 2, retention and capacity values all checked against the text, no wrong or misattributed value found. method_sources: ref7 entries are fine; ref27, 28, 29-32 are software, beamline and algorithm citations, correctly excluded. Substance: the extraction is faithful; the findings are deduced conditions, absent sub-results and annotation wording. The charge-balance arithmetic and the 1:1:2 Li2O:Mn2O3:LiF ratio in mecanisme_analyse were checked and are correct.
